// diagnostic E0106

Jet.BuiltinRedefined

Redefining a built-in

What

Redefining a built-in

Why

Built-in names mean the same thing in every file, so a declaration can't take one over

Fix

Rename the declaration so it does not shadow a built-in.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.BuiltinRedefined: Tests/UI/marker_named_like_a_trait.stderr.

Error: Jet.BuiltinRedefined: The marker name `Iterable` is the built-in trait `Iterable`
  --> Tests/UI/marker_named_like_a_trait.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | Iterable: struct {
    | ^^^^^^^^
 Why: A marker and a trait never share a name, so `Iterable` always means the one trait
 Fix: Choose a marker name that no trait has
